# Immerse Education

> Immerse Education offers academically rigorous summer programmes combining public speaking, communication skills, and career development for high school students across multiple global locations.

Immerse Education specializes in residential and online summer programmes for ages 14-18, with partnerships including TED and locations in major cities like London, New York, Boston, Cambridge, and Singapore. The platform integrates academic insights with practical career preparation through immersive learning experiences.

## Key Topics

- Public speaking

## Flagship Programmes

- [TED Summer School](https://www.ted.immerse.education): TED Summer School combining TED's platform with Immerse Education's academic excellence in New York and Singapore

## Support & Information

- [FAQs](https://help.immerse.education): FAQs covering enrollment, accommodation, visas, and programme details across Boston, Cambridge, London, New York
